liveOps.title: Early Access is live; Patch 0.11 has shipped
liveOps.description: WARDOGS is playable on Steam. Patch 0.11 deployed on September 14 at 08:00 UTC after about one hour of maintenance, rebuilding the server browser, fixing cash exploits, and adding Asia capacity.
liveOps.accessValue: Separate Official and Community browsers, better search and filters, persistent server IDs, cash and GPU fixes, and more Asia capacity.
liveOps.closedBetaNote: The revised Beta 02 server window ended on September 6 at 08:00 UTC. An old Playtest entitlement does not reopen it.

about.imageAlt: Official WARDOGS gameplay view from a helicopter cockpit
about.bodyOne: WARDOGS is BULKHEAD's live Steam Early Access tactical all-out warfare FPS, not the 2016 War Dogs movie. Up to 100 players in three teams contest a randomized 2 x 2 km Control Zone using infantry, vehicles, fortifications, and logistics.
about.bodyTwo: Cash persists between matches and funds a new loadout for each life. Combat and support actions can both help the team while sustaining your economy.
about.officialQuote: Every player starts their journey with $10,000.

aboutPage.metaTitle: About WARDOGS Wiki: Independent Player Reference
aboutPage.metaDescription: Learn who maintains WARDOGS Wiki, how its independent editorial team verifies game information, labels uncertain claims, and keeps player guides current.
aboutPage.title: About WARDOGS Wiki
aboutPage.intro: WARDOGS Wiki is an independently operated, unofficial player reference built to make changing game information easier to verify and use.
aboutPage.identityBody: The site documents WARDOGS access, equipment, controls, troubleshooting and tactics for players across six languages. It is maintained as a focused publication rather than an open-edit encyclopedia.
aboutPage.methodBody: Official Steam, Team17, BULKHEAD and WARDOGS sources lead factual updates. Creator footage and community reports are used only with clear labels, dates and build caveats.
aboutPage.independenceTitle: Independent from the game and advertisers
aboutPage.independenceBody: WARDOGS Wiki is not affiliated with BULKHEAD, Team17, Steam or creators. Advertising does not determine rankings, conclusions, source labels or corrections.

contactPage.metaTitle: Contact WARDOGS Wiki: Corrections and Source Tips
contactPage.metaDescription: Contact the independent WARDOGS Wiki editorial team about factual corrections, broken sources, missing guide evidence, or version-sensitive information.
contactPage.title: Contact WARDOGS Wiki
contactPage.intro: Use the public issue tracker for site corrections and evidence. Account, purchase, ban and server support must go to official WARDOGS services.
contactPage.correctionsTitle: Report a factual or site issue
contactPage.correctionsBody: Include the page URL, the disputed statement, a public source and the date or game build involved. Remove account names, tokens, receipts and personal information.
contactPage.gameSupportBody: This independent guide cannot change game access, payments, moderation decisions or server status. Use Steam or the official WARDOGS Discord for those requests.

editorial.metaTitle: WARDOGS Wiki Editorial Policy and Research Standards
editorial.metaDescription: See how WARDOGS Wiki verifies official claims, analyzes creator footage, labels build-sensitive details, corrects errors, and keeps every player guide current.
editorial.title: How We Research WARDOGS
editorial.intro: WARDOGS Wiki is an independent fan publication. Every guide is built to answer a player question clearly while separating official facts, observed footage, community reports, and unresolved claims.
editorial.teamBody: The WARDOGS Wiki Editorial Team maintains this focused game guide without affiliation to BULKHEAD, Team17, Steam, creators, or advertisers. Commercial relationships do not determine our conclusions or source labels.
editorial.officialBody: Release dates, prices, platforms, access rules, and feature claims are checked against Steam, Team17, BULKHEAD, or official WARDOGS channels before publication.
editorial.footageTitle: Footage is evidence, not final documentation
editorial.footageBody: Creator videos help explain controls, match flow, loadouts, vehicles, and tactics. Alpha and beta numbers remain labeled build-sensitive unless a current official source confirms them.
editorial.statusTitle: Confirmed and uncertain claims stay separate
editorial.statusBody: We mark rumors, community observations, and unknown details plainly. A missing answer is never converted into a confident release promise or final balance claim.
editorial.updatesTitle: Material updates earn a new date
editorial.updatesBody: Last-checked dates change when sources or guidance are meaningfully reviewed. Pages are not redated merely to appear fresh in search results.
editorial.correctionsTitle: Corrections remain part of the record
editorial.correctionsBody: When a source changes or an error is found, we update the affected guide, revise its status language, and preserve links that let readers verify the current conclusion.

privacy.metaTitle: WARDOGS Wiki Privacy Policy: Cookies, Analytics & Ads
privacy.metaDescription: Read how WARDOGS Wiki handles cookies, analytics, AdSense advertising, external media and links, and why the site does not collect game account credentials.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This fan guide minimizes data collection and explains how external media and links work.
privacy.content: We do not operate player accounts or collect game credentials. External services may apply their own privacy policies after you choose to open them.
privacy.advertising: We use Google AdSense to fund this site. Google may process your IP address, browser and device information, and use cookies or similar technologies to deliver, measure and personalize advertising where consent is required.
